translations.web: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.
translations.bsb: Should God repay you on your own terms when you have disavowed Him? You must choose, not I; so tell me what you know.
translations.kjv: Should it be according to thy mind? he will recompense it, whether thou refuse, or whether thou choose; and not I: therefore speak what thou knowest.
translations.asv: Shall his recompense be as thou wilt, that thou refusest it? For thou must choose, and not I: Therefore speak what thou knowest.
